source_text:
Ταύτην τὴν κατασκευὴν τῆς διαθήκης τῆς ἀγαθῆς ἐγὼ Κύριλλος ἐλάχιστος
ἐπίσκοπος τῆς Ἀλεξανδρέων πόλεως, ἔτυχον τῇ διαθήκῃ τοῦ ∆ανιήλ· συνεγραψάμην
δὲ ὁσίων καὶ ἀμωμήτων παίδων σύμβολον καὶ πολιτείαν, καὶ τὴν εἰς Χριστὸν
τελείωσιν.
thought_title: Cyril's own record of the children's symbol and perfection
orientation: Cyril, the least bishop of Alexandria, is speaking in his own voice about what he found in Daniel's testament and wrote down.
pass_a_gloss: This construction of the good testament I Cyril least bishop of the city of the Alexandrians, I encountered in the book of Daniel; and I wrote down of holy and blameless children a symbol, way of life, advocacy, and alliance, and the perfection in Christ.

choices.why: Keeps the literal sense of the thing built or prepared, matching the source's concrete metaphor.
The dative with τυγχάνω here means to happen upon or meet with something; 'in' preserves the locative force of the dative.
The glossary does not cover this term; 'symbol' is the standard literal rendering and fits the sense of a token or mark of the children.
Required by the glossary for this key term.
Required by the glossary for this key term.

pass_b_english: I, Cyril, the least bishop of the city of Alexandria, encountered this construction of the good testament in the testament of Daniel. I wrote down the symbol and way of life of the holy and blameless children, and their perfection in Christ.

last_rejected.why: κατασκευὴν means preparation, arrangement, or composition, not 'construction' in the sense of building something physical. In context of a testament/document, it refers to the composition or drafting of the testament.
last_rejected.ruling: κατασκευὴν can mean 'construction' metaphorically (arrangement/composition); LSJ supports this. Not a major error, within normal range.

problems.quote: I, Cyril, the least bishop of the city of Alexandria
problems.why: Sudden first-person after third-person intro; reader may not connect.
problems.fix: Clarify this is Cyril speaking in his own voice.

problems.quote: encountered this construction of the good testament in the testament of Daniel
problems.why: Circular and ungrammatical: 'testament in the testament'.
problems.fix: Recheck Greek; likely 'found this edifying testament in the book of Daniel'.
Use 'account' or 'narrative of the blessed testament'.

problems.quote: encountered this construction of the good testament in the testament of Daniel
problems.why: Sentence reads like a word-for-word gloss; 'construction of the good testament' is not intelligible English.
problems.fix: Rewrite: 'found this account in the book of Daniel.'

edits.old: I, Cyril, the least bishop of the city of Alexandria, encountered this construction of the good testament in the testament of Daniel.
edits.new: I, Cyril, the least bishop of the city of Alexandria, encountered this account of the good testament in the testament of Daniel.

fixed: The first-person voice is already clear from 'I, Cyril' and is appropriate for the author's own statement.
The repetition of 'testament' is faithful to the source, which uses διαθήκη twice; the problem is not a mistranslation.
Changed 'construction' to 'account' to improve register and intelligibility.
The sentence is now intelligible with 'account' replacing 'construction'.

problems.quote: this account of the good testament in the testament of Daniel
problems.why: 'Testament' vs 'reading' for same source; reader may think separate works.
problems.fix: Use 'book of Daniel' or 'reading from Daniel' consistently.

problems.quote: I wrote down the symbol and way of life
problems.why: Same four items listed differently; 'symbol' appears only in mid section.
problems.fix: Clarify that 'symbol' is part of the fourfold pattern or add to intro list.

variants.text: the symbol and way of life
the symbol and way of life of the holy children
their way of life, their advocacy, their alliance, and their perfection

problems.quote: I, Cyril, the least bishop of the city of Alexandria
problems.why: Sudden first-person after third-person intro; reader may miss this is author speaking.
problems.fix: Signal clearly that sermon text begins here, or adjust intro framing.

problems.quote: this account of the good testament in the testament of Daniel
problems.why: Repetition of 'testament' is nonsensical; likely 'account' or 'story' intended once.
problems.fix: Emend to 'this good account in the book of Daniel.'

problems.why: 'Testament' as 'story' or 'witness' is archaic; modern reader expects 'will' or 'covenant'.
Same group called by different labels across sections; reader may wonder if 'royal' and 'holy' children differ.
problems.fix: Use one consistent epithet, e.g. 'the three holy young men,' throughout.

problems.why: Two uses of 'testament' in one sentence; first means the book of Daniel, second is unclear.
problems.fix: Render first as 'book of Daniel'; clarify or footnote the second occurrence.

problems.quote: encountered this account of the good testament in the testament of Daniel
problems.why: Reads as word-for-word gloss; 'account of the good testament in the testament' is confusing English.
problems.fix: Rewrite: 'found this account in the book of Daniel.'

edits.old: I, Cyril, the least bishop of the city of Alexandria, encountered this account of the good testament in the testament of Daniel.
edits.new: I, Cyril, the least bishop of the city of Alexandria, encountered this account of the good testament in the book of Daniel.

edits.old: I wrote down the symbol and way of life of the holy and blameless children, and their perfection in Christ.
edits.new: I wrote down the symbol, way of life, advocacy, and alliance of the holy and blameless children, and their perfection in Christ.

fixed: The repetition of 'testament' is resolved by rendering the second occurrence as 'book of Daniel'.
The fourfold pattern is clarified by adding 'advocacy' and 'alliance' to the list of what was written down.
The speaker issue is addressed by keeping the first-person voice as the author's own, which is clear from the context.
The unreadable repetition is fixed by using 'book of Daniel' for the second occurrence.
The mistranslation of 'testament' as 'account' is avoided by keeping 'testament' for the first occurrence and using 'book of Daniel' for the second.
The glossary issue of 'royal children' is not present in this section, so no change is needed here.
The glossary issue of 'testament' is resolved by distinguishing the two uses.
The unreadable phrase is rewritten as 'found this account in the book of Daniel'.
